THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Declaration under Section 7 My No.: KOT/LND/ACQVI/01/51. Land Min. Reference No.: LD/05/2001/UDA/399. I hereby notify under Sub-section (7) of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: Allotments of the land situated at Mathugobe Village in the Grama Niladhari’s Division, Deniyaya (243) of the Divisional Secretariat, Kotapola in Matara District in Southern Province, depicted from Lot No. 1444 to Lot No. 1450 of Supplementary Sheet No. 128 of Sheet No. 110 in F. V. P. 169 made by the Surveyor General, containing in extent about 0.9373 Hectare and boundaries of the land given below:

1. Lot No. 1444—Name of the Land: Pitadeniya and Pitadeniyahena: First Claimant:Not Found; Extent: about 0.0247 Hectare. North: Lot Nos. 694 and 182;East: Lot Nos. 181 and 191B;South:Lot Nos. 191B and 1449;West: Lot No. 1449.

2. Lot No. 1445—Name of the Land: Pitadeniyahena: First Claimant: Not Found; Extent: about 0.0010 Hectare. North: Lot No. 694 ;East: Lot No. 694;South:Lot No. 1449;West: Lot No. 1449. 3. 7. Lot No. 1450—Name of the Land: Pitadeniya, Pitawela or Mahadeniya and Malagalla; First Claimant of the Land, W. K. Geethalatha Deniyaya; Extent about 0.1346 Hectare. North: Lot No. 191B; East: Lot No. 191B; South: Lot No. 191B; West: Lot No. 191B. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretaniat, Kotapola on 26.09.2016 at 10.00 a.m. Further, I hereby requested to notify to me in writing

(in duplicate) on or before the 19.09.2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of compensation of such amount.
GANESHA AMARASINGHA, Divisional Secretary, Kotapola. Divisional Secretariat at the Kotapola, 4th August, 2016. 08 - 598
